label: host-vocabulary
scope: pooled screen + held-out; partially pre-specified (held-out G rows were not in the frozen heldout_spec; screen G rows were not blind)
rule: computed on the POOLED rows: 'artefact' if G1-multi IRR/SD < 1.10 with a CI including 1 AND the G1 MDE <= 1.20 AND G3(combined) removes > 50% of the log-IRR; otherwise the G2a reading ('grafting' / 'host-vocabulary'; 'unresolved' if G2a is unresolved).
